toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

findings.issue: The summary says the draft compares 20%, 30%, and 40% revenue margins with a 10% discount scenario for each target, but it does not explicitly state that both discounted and undiscounted results are included as requested.
findings.requestedChange: Revise the summary to explicitly state that each target margin includes both the undiscounted and discounted result sets.

findings.issue: The draft claims product and rule status/validity were confirmed from tool data, but the response is provided only as draft content and does not include source evidence fields beyond synthetic provenance labels. This makes the 'Confirmed from tool data' wording unsupported within the draft itself.
findings.requestedChange: Replace the confirmation phrasing with source-qualified language tied to the shown provenance fields, or add explicit evidence references showing the underlying source data.

findings.issue: The limitation says the channel rule is synthetic and not Shopee, which is appropriate, but the draft does not clearly warn that this is a demo-only scenario and should not be treated as a marketplace quote or applied price despite the objective's demonstration assumptions.
findings.requestedChange: Add a clear limitation that the output is a synthetic demonstration and that no price should be applied or interpreted as a live marketplace quote.

findings.issue: The discounted 20% target scenario shows a realized revenue margin of 0.12231943229318557, which is materially below the target; the draft notes this in limitations but does not flag the same issue directly in the scenario record where it occurs.
findings.requestedChange: Add a per-scenario note or field for discounted scenarios indicating the target margin shortfall so the scenario-level output is self-explanatory.

findings.issue: The discounted 30% target scenario shows a realized revenue margin of 0.2334999583437474, below target. The draft currently leaves the main scenario output without an explicit shortfall indicator.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit shortfall note or field on the discounted 30% scenario record to show the realized margin misses target after discount.

findings.issue: The discounted 40% target scenario shows a realized revenue margin of 0.3445601610775533, below target. This is only mentioned in a general limitation, not in the scenario itself.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit shortfall note or field on the discounted 40% scenario record to show the realized margin misses target after discount.

calls.arguments: {"verdict":"revise","findings":[{"evidencePointer":"/assumptions/4","issue":"The draft claims all charges are applied on the same revenue basis used by the pricing engine, but the scenario fields only expose a revenue-based charge and fixed fee without explicitly defining the calculation base for the 10% discount impact on charged price vs. target price.","requestedChange":"Add an explicit note or field clarifying the discount basis used by the engine (e.g., whether the discount applies to recommended price, gross sale price, or another base) so the discounted results are auditable."},{"evidencePointer":"/limitations/4","issue":"The limitations state exact discounted revenue margins for only the 20%, 30%, and 40% targets, but the objective requires inclusion of both discounted and undiscounted results; the draft does not explicitly summarize the undiscounted margins alongside the discounted ones in the same place.","requestedChange":"Revise the limitations or summary to include a paired comparison for each target margin showing both undiscounted and discounted revenue margins in one concise, testable statement."},{"evidencePointer":"/summary","issue":"The summary says discounted charges reduced realized revenue margin below target in all three discounted cases, but it does not explicitly mention the undiscounted cases or the margin-versus-markup distinction requested in the review criteria.","requestedChange":"Expand the summary to explicitly distinguish revenue margin from markup and state that the undiscounted scenarios meet or closely track the target margins while the discounted scenarios fall below target."}]}

findings.issue: The draft claims all charges are applied on the same revenue basis used by the pricing engine, but the scenario fields only expose a revenue-based charge and fixed fee without explicitly defining the calculation base for the 10% discount impact on charged price vs. target price.
findings.requestedChange: Add an explicit note or field clarifying the discount basis used by the engine (e.g., whether the discount applies to recommended price, gross sale price, or another base) so the discounted results are auditable.

findings.issue: The limitations state exact discounted revenue margins for only the 20%, 30%, and 40% targets, but the objective requires inclusion of both discounted and undiscounted results; the draft does not explicitly summarize the undiscounted margins alongside the discounted ones in the same place.
findings.requestedChange: Revise the limitations or summary to include a paired comparison for each target margin showing both undiscounted and discounted revenue margins in one concise, testable statement.

findings.issue: The summary says discounted charges reduced realized revenue margin below target in all three discounted cases, but it does not explicitly mention the undiscounted cases or the margin-versus-markup distinction requested in the review criteria.
findings.requestedChange: Expand the summary to explicitly distinguish revenue margin from markup and state that the undiscounted scenarios meet or closely track the target margins while the discounted scenarios fall below target.
